questions.q: In a $45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ$ triangle, the hypotenuse is $10\sqrt{2}$. What is the length of each leg?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $10$. In a 45-45-90 triangle, hypotenuse $= s\sqrt{2} \implies s\sqrt{2} = 10\sqrt{2} \implies s = 10$.

questions.q: What is the area of a circle with radius $8$? (Express your answer in terms of $\pi$.)
questions.answer: Applying Area, Volume, Triangles, Circles & Trigonometry principles, Area $=\pi r^2=\pi (8)^2=64\pi$ Therefore, the verified correct option is $64\pi$.
